convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load the proprietary 'JBrainTrend1Stop' custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution logic (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose). Custom indicator signals cannot be replicated without the indicator source.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
derived_values.used_by: BarsCalculated readiness check and bar count validation

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade timing

other_exits: BuyPosClose and SellPosClose input booleans gate whether signal-reversal closes are executed

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum determines sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. The MM input value (0.1) is the lot when MMMode=LOT, or the fraction of margin/balance otherwise.

custom_logic_notes: Signal logic: UpTrend buffer (index 1) non-zero at bar [SignalBar+1] indicates uptrend state; combined with DnTrend buffer (index 0) non-zero at bar [SignalBar] confirms trend transition from down to up = buy signal. Vice versa for sell. Signal is latched within a bar via static BUY_Open/SELL_Open flags and only recalculated on new bar or when Recount=true. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans act as independent gates allowing selective enable/disable of each trade direction. LoadHistory() call ensures bar data availability. GlobalVariableDel_ cleans up global variables on deinit.
python_conversion_notes: The JBrainTrend1Stop custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python. It combines ATR, Stochastic, JMA smoothing, and a stop algorithm. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_) must all be reimplemented. The margin mode enum (LOT/FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE) sizing logic is encapsulated in TradeAlgorithms.mqh and needs careful porting. Signal time tracking (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) is passed to trade functions and may be used for order timing or duplicate trade prevention. The static Recount flag provides a retry mechanism on data gaps that must be preserved.
